initial:
Use case: precise-object-edit / background-extraction.
Asset: transparent production UI artwork for a Unity game.
Image 1 is the AUTHORITATIVE design. Copy ONLY the THREE VERTICALLY STACKED SKILL BUTTONS at the extreme right of image 1 (approximately x1470..1645,y300..750 in the 1647x955 reference). Do not redesign them. Extract/reconstruct this exact complete UI group on real transparent background, large high resolution portrait canvas.
Image 2 supplies ONLY the already approved three cream pictograms. Replace the arrow in top button with the flame, middle arrow with the shield, bottom arrow with the sprout pushing through stone. Preserve these pictogram designs, all upright, fitted like the original arrows.
Strictly preserve image 1's actual button silhouettes and relationships: three dark charcoal translucent circular ink-wash interiors; coral-red smooth hand-painted rings with deliberately varying stroke weight; the middle ring has a broad thick red crescent on the RIGHT; the upper ring is thinner and open near bottom; original flowing red S-shaped connectors connect rings in the narrow gap between them (not a long wire down the outer edge); exact sparse red teardrop accent clusters at left/right matching reference; bottom ring follows the original asymmetric red loop. Keep the circles similar in size with the exact spacing/proportions from reference. The group is one coherent hand-painted design. It is not three identical outline circles. Retain charcoal dark translucent backplates inside each ring, so symbols read against a busy game scene. Preserve warm cream pictogram color. Keep original red color, smooth rounded-tapered strokes and subtle matte paper finish, flat cartoon art. No 3D, plastic, bevel, glow, shadows outside artwork, new ornaments, leaves, words or keyboard arrows.
Framing: show ONLY the full isolated group, centered on portrait canvas with generous 6% transparent margin all around; no parts clipped. No forest, ground, characters, reference background, other HUD or comparison boards. Real alpha transparency around and between button artwork, not a checkerboard painted into the image. Dark interiors are intentional partially opaque UI components, not background to remove.
Faithfulness to Image 1's right-hand control UI is the primary objective. Do not use the HUD avatar rings or invent a new geometric ring system.
revision:
Use case precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the STRICT AUTHORITATIVE reference. Its RIGHTMOST 3 stacked skill buttons must be copied in silhouette and proportions. Image 2 is an edit target which is CLOSE BUT HAS WRONG OUTLINES. Correct image 2 using image 1. Output only the isolated vertical 3-button UI on genuine transparent background.
KEEP unchanged: warm cream flame/shield/sprout-through-rock symbols in that order, dark charcoal translucent ink interiors, coral red color, smooth flat matte handpainted style, same canvas size/margins.
CHANGE ONLY framing to faithfully match image 1:
1. REMOVE the strange round red disk at the lower right of top circle entirely. It does not exist in reference.
2. Top ring: make the outline thin on its upper/left arc and rounded thicker along the lower right, with a genuine small opening near 5 o'clock before the connecting stroke. NOT a uniform closed ring.
3. Middle ring: reproduce the reference's very pronounced right-hand solid crescent: outer edge convex right and inner edge scooped inward, narrowing to tapered tips at upper right and lower right. Its left outline is a separate much thinner open arc. Do not make a thick outline all around a circular center. This is the most important correction.
4. Bottom ring: thinner left/lower outline, thicker right upper arc, gently asymmetric, small opening at the top left. Don't use a generic closed circle.
5. Connecting S strokes: same distinctive fluid curling connections between adjacent rings as image 1. Thin tapered flowing ink, not a fat uniform S tube.
6. Accent droplets: copy only original positions: two small red droplets left of top button, two on right of middle, two right of bottom. No extra disks or speckled red haze. Clean transparent margins.
No new design. No text, keyboard arrows, scene, characters, shadows or checkerboard. Preserve actual alpha transparency. Large portrait production asset, sharp smooth silhouette, only subtle paper finish.
